concept: THE DORMANT FIELD. A 744-billion-parameter model runs in 25 GB of RAM because only the experts a single token needs are ever awake. We open on the impossible pairing, state the myth (a model this big belongs in a datacenter), then SHOW the mechanism: a field of thousands of experts sits dark on disk while a few flare and stream in per token. We make the scale mismatch concrete (370 GB on disk vs 9.9 GB resident), land the payoff number (25 GB) full-frame, show the plain one-C-file engine, and restate the pairing to rhyme with the open. Node-diagram + terminal was the default and is explicitly killed.
money_shot_note: TWENTY_FIVE_GIGS (scene 5 of 7, ~71%) is the peak: the whole memory footprint slams full-frame on a bright ember field. The split (disk vs RAM) now precedes the metaphor so the paradox lands before the explanation, and so the video's brightest plate scene is not at the midpoint. The one reserved glitch transition and whoosh-thud button fire only on the cut into the money shot.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts throughout (register cut). Motion carries through the cuts (experts already streaming as ONLY_WHAT_WAKES enters, the split panels already sliding). The single reserved glitch effect fires once, on the cut into the money shot.
music_direction: Electronic-leaning bed with a clear onset to land the money-shot cut on. Restrained under the dim body scenes, opening up at the flash. Foley whoosh-thud on the money beat only, no per-cut swipe.
